text.description_html:
Bommer BB5001-450-613, 4-1/2" x 4-1/2" x Square Corners Brass Hinge, Oil Rubbed Bronze

Package includes one (1) complete hinge with matching solid brass flathead, Phillips Drive #12 x 1-1/4" wood screws and 12-24 x 1/2" machine screws.

Fitted with a high grade, removable, rust resistant, stainless steel button tip hinge pin. Medium duty door hinge, standard .134" thickness. Standard full mortise hinge with 5 knuckle design and button tips.

Specifications for the Bommer BB5001-450 4-1/2" x 4-1/2" Brass Hinge:

  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Hinge Material: Solid Brass
  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 4-1/2"
  • Corners: Square
  • Hinge Pin: Stainless Steel, Removable
  • Dual Ball-Bearing: 2 Ball Bearings
  • Hinge Type: Full Mortise
  • Thickness: 0.134"
  • Non-Handed
  • Non-Rising Removable Pin
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Full Mortise - Conforms to ANSI A2112 for Ball Bearing Hinges
  • Wood Screws: 4 ea. #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: 8 ea. #12-24 x 1/2"
  • Bommer BB5001-450 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Package with matching finish machine screws and wood screws. For use with both metal and wood doors.

Sold Individually (1 door hinge)

** Clearance Priced, limited quantities available.
